problem.text: Fire and explosion hazard: flammable fumes, such as solvent and paint fumes, in work area can ignite or explode

actions.text: Use equipment only in well ventilated area.
Eliminate all ignition sources; such as pilot lights, cigarettes, portable electric lamps, and plastic drop cloths (potential static arc).
Keep work area free of debris, including solvent, rags and gasoline.
Do not plug or unplug power cords, or turn power or light switches on or off when flammable fumes are present.
Ground all equipment in the work area. See Grounding instructions.
Use only grounded hoses.
Hold gun firmly to side of grounded pail when triggering into pail.
If there is static sparking or you feel a shock, stop operation immediately.
actions.condition: If there is static sparking or you feel a shock

actions.text: Do not use equipment until you identify and correct the problem.
Keep a working fire extinguisher in the work area.

references.external: Grounding instructions (not in this manual; probably Operation manual 313384)

evidence.quote: Flammable fumes, such as solvent and paint fumes, in work area can ignite or explode.

branches.note: Il riferimento 'Grounding instructions' non esiste in questo manuale (18 pagine verificate): probabilmente nel manuale operativo 313384; target non verificabile.

problem.text: Equipment misuse hazard: misuse can cause death or serious injury

actions.text: Do not operate the unit when fatigued or under the influence of drugs or alcohol.
Do not exceed the maximum working pressure or temperature rating of the lowest rated system component. See Technical Data in all equipment manuals.
Use fluids and solvents that are compatible with equipment wetted parts. See Technical Data in all equipment manuals. Read fluid and solvent manufacturer's warnings.
For complete information about your material, request MSDS forms from distributor or retailer.
Do not alter or modify equipment.
Use equipment only for its intended purpose. Call your distributor for information.
Route hoses and cables away from traffic areas, sharp edges, moving parts, and hot surfaces.
Do not kink or over bend hoses or use hoses to pull equipment.
Keep children and animals away from work area.
Comply with all applicable safety regulations.

references.text: See Technical Data in all equipment manuals.
